# Fake research corpus

Everything here is **fictional**. The CVE (`CVE-2099-12345`), the product ("AcmeDocs"), the
vendors, hosts and versions do not exist. The documents imitate the shapes real sources take
(vendor advisory, security blog with page furniture, CERT note, mailing-list post, GitHub
advisory API response, repository README, Exploit-DB page, a syndicated mirror, an unrelated
page) plus hostile variants (prompt injection in visible text, hidden elements and HTML comments).
They are used to test extraction, filtering, deduplication, screening and grounding without
touching the network. `example.test` and RFC 5737 addresses are used for all hosts.
